details.subjective_justification: The agent systematically identified the bug in the `_cstack` function by understanding the issue, examining the code, creating test cases to confirm the problem, applying a minimal one-line fix, and verifying it with both the original test case and the full test suite—all with clear logical progression and no errors or dead-ends.

The agent correctly identified the bug (RST.__init__ not accepting header_rows), traced through the codebase to understand how FixedWidth handles it, implemented a fix by accepting and passing header_rows to parent class and adjusting data.start_line dynamically, and verified with passing tests; reasoning was mostly clear with minor exploration overhead but no errors or backtracking.

The agent correctly identified the root cause (case-sensitive regex) and applied a fix, but initially made an unnecessary change to line 309 (adding `.upper()` to handle 'NO' values) that wasn't required by the bug report, then reverted to a simpler solution using `re.IGNORECASE` flag; the reasoning was mostly sound but had some redundant exploration, and recovery was good when tests confirmed the simpler approach worked.
